summary: Conviction for murder under Section 302 IPC upheld based on eyewitness testimony (PW-1 and PW-8) and discovery of blood-stained hammer at accused's instance under Section 27 Evidence Act. Appellant challenged reliability of witnesses and delay in FIR; State defended concurrent findings. Court found no perversity in lower courts' appreciation of evidence.
legal_provisions_cited: State of Madras v. A. Vaidyanatha Iyer, (1958) SCR 580
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; conviction and sentence of life imprisonment affirmed.
